title: places details result record (v1)
description: One requested POI id of a places details invocation as one JSONL result record, at its original zero-based input position: present true with the usable textual members the returned detail entry carried, or present false as the placeholder of a missing or expired id. A duplicate input id renders again at each of its positions. Absent members are omitted, never emitted as null; the rich nested structures of the detail response stay with the lossless data.upstream array of the JSON envelope.

position.$comment: The original zero-based position of the id in the invocation's input order.

id.$comment: The opaque, ephemeral upstream POI id exactly as the caller supplied it; never validated for internal format.

present.$comment: Whether the chunk's response carried an entry matching this position's id.

display_address.$comment: The display address of the entry's postal address block.

phone.$comment: The telephone of the entry's contact block.

email.$comment: The email of the entry's contact block.

thumbnail.$comment: The source url of the entry's thumbnail block.
